e.title: Reinsure-8B（保险/再保原生大模型）
e.summary: 自述「全球首个保险原生语言模型」（8B，基于 Llama-3）：以再保险为原生定位
e.summary_en: Self-described "world’s first insurance-native language model" (8B, Llama-3 based): natively positioned on reinsurance
e.summary_hk: 自述「全球首個保險原生語言模型」（8B，基於 Llama-3）：以再保險為原生定位
e.body:
Reinsure-8B（Reinsured AI，HuggingFace，2026-03-14 发布，Llama-3 8B 架构，支持 vLLM 文本生成，截至核实 104 次下载）自我定位为「**The world’s first insurance-native language model**」（全球首个保险原生语言模型），标签含 insurance / reinsurance / sovereign-ai。对 RIAA：池内保险领域模型已有若干——通用保险语料的 [[open-insurance-llm]]、行业 BERT 的 [[llmware-industry-bert-insurance]]、精算对话方向的 [[morbi]] 与 [[insurance-expert-llama3b-lora]]、语音的 [[insurance-voice-qwen]]——但**以「再保险」为原生定位的基座模型这是第一条**。这个定位有实质意义：再保险的术语与业务逻辑（分层、摊回、比例/非比例、合约与临分）与传统直保差异明显，通用保险语料未必覆盖。可与再保侧其他条目配合阅读：合约数据见 [[reinsurance-contracts-repository]]，合约文本抽取见 [[re-ink-reinsurance]]，业务概念见 [[reinsurance]]；框架侧参考 [[insurance-llm-framework]]。注意：下载量仅 104，属**新发布、采用度尚低**的模型，且模型卡未提供评测指标——使用前需自行验证输出质量。

## 同类工具
[[revdbayes]]、[[risk-profiler]]、[[riskportfolios]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
e.body_en:
Reinsure-8B (by Reinsured AI, on HuggingFace, released 2026-03-14, Llama-3 8B architecture, vLLM text generation, 104 downloads at verification) describes itself as "**The world’s first insurance-native language model**", tagged insurance / reinsurance / sovereign-ai. For RIAA: this corpus already holds several insurance-domain models — [[open-insurance-llm]] (general insurance corpus), [[llmware-industry-bert-insurance]] (industry BERT), [[morbi]] and [[insurance-expert-llama3b-lora]] (actuarial dialogue), and [[insurance-voice-qwen]] (voice) — but **this is the first foundation model positioned natively on reinsurance**. That positioning matters: reinsurance terminology and mechanics (layers, recoveries, proportional vs non-proportional, treaty vs facultative) differ markedly from direct insurance, so a general insurance corpus may not cover them. Read it with the other reinsurance-side entries: contract data in [[reinsurance-contracts-repository]], contract-text extraction in [[re-ink-reinsurance]], and the business concepts in [[reinsurance]]; for the framework side see [[insurance-llm-framework]]. Note: only 104 downloads — a **newly released, low-adoption** model with no evaluation metrics in the model card, so verify output quality yourself before use.

## Similar tools
[[revdbayes]]、[[risk-profiler]]、[[riskportfolios]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
